title: Review-by date for the nine realignment risks
source: 11 Delivery and operations/Recovery Workbench Risks Assumptions Issues and Dependencies v4.xlsx
description: The source dates the review of each of the 18 risks. The nine realignment risks R1 to R9 that D-RCV-60 adds have no review date in the source workbook, the Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 or the Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1; the extracts give waves, not review dates.
evidence: Risks sheet rows R-01 to R-18, column Review by, all dated; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 38 gives the waves; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 gives versions and governance, not review dates.
proposed: Set the review date of R-19 to R-27 at the first risk review after Wave 0, in step with the wave plan of Architecture v5 slide 38.

title: Numbering of the nine realignment risks
source: 11 Delivery and operations/Recovery Workbench Risks Assumptions Issues and Dependencies v4.xlsx; WP B-DELIVDOC-48
description: The work package asks for realignment risks R1 to R9. The workbook already numbers its risks R-01 to R-18, so an unqualified R1 to R9 collides with the source series and would break the rule that every source ID is kept character for character.
evidence: WP B-DELIVDOC-48 note 'add realignment risks R1-R9'; Risks sheet ID column R-01 to R-18.
proposed: Number the nine realignment risks R-19 to R-27 in the same series and print the R1 to R-19 mapping in the Read me sheet and in the Risks cover row.

title: Owner vocabulary for risks, assumptions and dependencies after the realignment
source: 11 Delivery and operations/Recovery Workbench Risks Assumptions Issues and Dependencies v4.xlsx; 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Ownership Map v1.xlsx
description: The source owner cells name roles and parties outside the 19 services. The realignment assigns each table, endpoint and event to one of the 19 services plus the platform, so the workbook has two owner vocabularies and no rule yet for combining them.
evidence: Risks sheet column Owner (Solution architect, Data lead, ACE team and similar); Dependencies sheet column Owner; Ownership Map v1 Services and Tables sheets (P1 to P10, S1 to S9, PLT).
proposed: Keep the source role and add the Ownership Map v1 service code and name in brackets where the map assigns the item to a service; keep the source owner where the owner sits outside the 19 services.
